# FlareSpacing

`Flare.Components.FlareSpacing`

Design-token spacing values for gap, padding, and margin parameters. Maps to pre-compiled CSS modifier classes using the component's spacing scale.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No spacing (0). |
| `XXSmall` | `1` | Extra-extra-small spacing (0.25 rem / 4 px). |
| `XSmall` | `2` | Extra-small spacing (0.5 rem / 8 px). |
| `Small` | `3` | Small spacing (0.75 rem / 12 px). |
| `Medium` | `4` | Medium spacing (1 rem / 16 px). Default for most layout components. |
| `Large` | `5` | Large spacing (1.5 rem / 24 px). |
| `XLarge` | `6` | Extra-large spacing (2 rem / 32 px). |
| `Custom` | `7` | Use a raw CSS value supplied via the companion *Value parameter. |

- `FlareCardActions`
- `FlareDrawer`
- `FlareGrid`
- `FlarePaper`
- `FlareStack`
